crypto-scam-inflows.title: Crypto Scam and Fraud Inflows
crypto-scam-inflows.caption: Chainalysis counted at least $14 billion received by scams in 2025 and projects the total could exceed $17 billion as more addresses are identified. The figures cover crypto scams broadly, not airdrops alone.
crypto-scam-inflows.source: Chainalysis, 2026 Crypto Crime Report: Scams, published January 13, 2026. Checked October 4, 2026.

crypto-scam-average-payment.title: Average Crypto Scam Payment
crypto-scam-average-payment.caption: The average payment to a scam rose 253% in a year, according to Chainalysis.
crypto-scam-average-payment.source: Chainalysis, 2026 Crypto Crime Report: Scams, published January 13, 2026. Checked October 4, 2026.

loss-recovery-gain.title: Gain Needed to Recover a Loss
loss-recovery-gain.caption: The gain needed equals the loss divided by one minus the loss, so recovery always takes a larger percentage than the fall.
loss-recovery-gain.note: Arithmetic illustration, not market data or a forecast.

crypto-position-size-impact.title: Portfolio Loss From a 60% Crypto Decline
crypto-position-size-impact.caption: Illustrative calculation assuming other portfolio holdings are unchanged.
crypto-position-size-impact.note: Arithmetic illustration, not market data or a forecast.

stress-test-by-allocation.title: Portfolio Decline in the Stress Scenario
stress-test-by-allocation.caption: Scenario from the text: stocks fall 25% and crypto falls 60%, with the rest of the portfolio in stocks and no interaction effects.
stress-test-by-allocation.note: Arithmetic illustration, not market data or a forecast.

microsoft-revenue-operating-income.title: Microsoft Revenue and Operating Income, Fiscal 2024 to 2026
microsoft-revenue-operating-income.caption: Operating income grew 21% in fiscal 2026, faster than revenue at 18%. Fiscal years end June 30.
microsoft-revenue-operating-income.source: Microsoft Corporation, fiscal 2026 Form 10-K, filed July 2026. Checked October 12, 2026.

stock-screener-entry-costs.title: Entry Paid Plans for Five Stock Screeners, Monthly Equivalent on Annual Billing
stock-screener-entry-costs.caption: Annual prices divided by 12: Yahoo Finance Bronze $95.40, Morningstar Investor $249, and Finviz Elite $299.50 a year. TradingView and Koyfin publish their annual-billing monthly rates directly. Plans differ in features, so the chart compares cost only.
stock-screener-entry-costs.source: Platform pricing pages and published plan listings for Finviz, Koyfin, Morningstar, TradingView, and Yahoo Finance. Checked October 12, 2026.

financial-analyst-employment-outlook.title: Financial and Investment Analyst Employment, 2025 and Projected 2035
financial-analyst-employment-outlook.caption: BLS projects an increase of 27,100 jobs, or 7%, against 3% for all occupations. The category is broader than equity research. The 2035 figure is a projection.
financial-analyst-employment-outlook.source: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics, Occupational Outlook Handbook, Financial Analysts, 2025 to 2035 projections. Checked October 12, 2026.

gdp-per-capita-2026.title: GDP Per Capita in Selected Economies, 2026 IMF Estimates
gdp-per-capita-2026.caption: Nominal GDP per capita at market exchange rates, rounded. These are IMF estimates for 2026, not final national accounts, and exchange-rate moves can change them.
gdp-per-capita-2026.source: International Monetary Fund, World Economic Outlook, April 2026. Checked October 12, 2026.
